steps.content: The audience gasps in unison, scattering like startled crows to clear a widening circle around you both.

Schorl shoots out from your pocket, primed to fire, but she swings her blades in a flash of steel at its smooth surface. With a deft twist, she hurls it aside and lunges at you, closing the distance in a heartbeat.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Chief, the shackles!
[Release the shackles]
It does buy you a moment's opportunity. The shackles' power already thrums in your palm, but as you raise your hand, she deftly evades. In a breath, she's right before you.
[CG]
She slips into your embrace with fox-like grace. Before you are her eyes brimming with tender affection, yet behind your neck lingers the unmistakable threat of her blades.

The blades delicately circle your neck as the dancer glides around you like a drifting petal caught in a breeze. Her lips hover near yours, curved in a smile that offers no answer. You can't tell whether she means to brush a kiss or sink her teeth into your pulse.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: ...Hehe, just for fun. You don't mind, do you?

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: It's just a dance, nothing more. I hope everyone enjoyed it.
The cool sensation at your nape subsides as she leans in close to your face. A whisper like a gentle breeze brushes past your ear, fading before you can make out the words.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You...?

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Chief!
A blue glow flickers as Schorl seizes an opening and strikes from behind her. The force is so powerful that it seems to pierce through the woman's body and into yours.
There she collapses into your arms, her eyes half-lidded, the same faint smile lingering on her lips. Around you, flustered guards rush forward to confirm your safety.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: Chief, please stop charging in like that! Protecting you is our job, not the other way around! Otherwise, our Captain's gonna skin us alive when we report back!

options: I don't think she's the kind of "danger" we expected.

steps.content: As you speak, you gather the twin blades from the ground. They're mere paper props, edges blunt and harmless.
...But what ripped through the canvas? Was it her own hand? Or some kind of ability?

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: That was all part of the performance design. At the dance's climax, Jasmine selects an audience member for interaction, though we certainly never expected she'd choose the Chief of Minos of all people. My sincerest apologies for startling you, Chief.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: All part of the design... huh? Well, I actually have some questions.

options: Why is there a Sinner in your delegation?

steps.content: His face registers evident shock.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: Is that so? I'm sorry, we don't know much about Sinners.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Okay, let me ask another question. The Outland Affairs Bureau already conducted a security check on all registered members of your delegation when you first arrived and didn't identify any Sinners at the time.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So who is she? And how did she manage to evade both inspection and registration?

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: Jasmine wasn't initially part of our delegation. We came across her in WhiteSands. Though her health was fragile, she was quite determined to accompany us to DisCity. I believe this city holds special significance for her.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: Her passion moved me deeply, so I extended the invitation myself. To think such an accident would follow... Do you intend to suspend the Great Expo?
He wears the look of a man poised for drama, eyes alight with anticipation—a sight you can't help but find amusing.

options: There's no need to make such a big deal of it.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: She didn't show any obvious hostility just now. Let's not spoil the fun for everyone.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But I do need to bring her back to MBCC for proper registration. You don't have any objections to that, do you?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: By the way, even before this accident, I had noticed that her physical condition was a bit worrisome. Over at the Bureau, she can get better treatment, though it might take quite some time.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This is all for the safety and well-being of the delegation members.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: That would be for the best. I should thank you on Jasmine's behalf.
He hesitates briefly before nodding in agreement. You can't tell whether it's genuine reluctance or just an act, but either way, he quickly has someone go along with him.

steps.speaker: Fraser Ambassador
steps.content: Advisor Campbell, just a reminder, she is an auction item. After that performance just now, many clients have already placed bids.
Adelaide Campbell shows a resigned expression.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: Ah, my apologies, Chief—it slipped my mind. Fraser operates on mercantile principles quite distinct from your own. Might I suggest we continue this conversation in a more discreet setting?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: In that case, I'll make an offer, no matter the cost. Ideally, I'd like to keep her long-term.
Schorl, floating beside you, freezes for a moment.

steps.speaker: Nirvana Representative
steps.content: Well, well, Parfait, seems you've finally met someone who can actually play the game. I'm curious, Chief—is MBCC paying you enough to pass up the stock market guru's offer? Or are you planning to "reallocate" city funds to outbid an ordinary citizen?

Like all the others from Nirvana, the man treats you with the same hostility. Your gaze flicks from him to the stock market guru at his side. She's already watching you—and when your eyes meet, she offers a faint, deliberate nod.

steps.speaker: Nirvana Representative
steps.content: I'm just joking. My friend here has already secured the winning bid. We've got an exclusive dinner party coming up and could use such a lovely flower to light up the place.

steps.speaker: Nirvana Representative
steps.content: If you are so fond of her, Chief, perhaps you should try to secure an invitation instead... though I doubt it'd be that easy for you.
Before you can respond, another person speaks up.

steps.speaker: Fraser Ambassador
steps.content: Excuse me, but Miss Parfait isn't currently in the top spot. The leading bid at the moment is...
He displays a shocking figure on his terminal.

steps.speaker: Nirvana Representative
steps.content: How is this price even possible...?! Who is it?!
You notice a woman in red on the upper floor, watching the scene with evident amusement.

steps.speaker: Fraser Ambassador
steps.content: This is, indeed, a highly competitive bid. The lady who placed it mentioned it was for a friend of hers. However, she also made a point of informing me that...

steps.speaker: Fraser Ambassador
steps.content: If Chief ${PlayerName} is interested, she would be pleased to offer it as a gift. She mentioned that it could be seen as... the start of a friendship.
When you look up, the woman in red meets your gaze, acknowledging you with a subtle gesture, then turns and walks away.

steps.speaker: Nirvana Representative
steps.content: Which city-state is she from? This isn't how business works here! Let us speak with her! It's not every day that my friend here finds something that she likes. We can't just let that—
A hand is placed on his shoulder.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: It's all right, my friend. Let's not allow tensions to rise. The lady put it well—art exists to bridge souls, not to parade fortunes. That would be most inelegant.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: If our beautiful blade dancer could once again perform freely in the sunlight after her treatment, my greatest wish would be fulfilled.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: It's been a pleasure to meet you, esteemed Chief. I won't keep you from your duties. Until fate brings us together again.
She gestures to you with such refined elegance that you can't discern whether there's any deeper meaning behind it.
In contrast, the wealthy elites dispersing in her wake all wear visibly disgruntled expressions.

steps.speaker: Nirvana Representative
steps.content: That one... He's a watchdog for the Sinners, if I remember correctly. Are you two close? You seem pretty worked up calling his name just now.
steps.female_content: That one... She's a watchdog for the Sinners, if I remember correctly. Are you two close? You seem pretty worked up calling her name just now.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Absolutely not! Back in my campaign days, I did try to work with him, but that guy is impossible! Naturally, we went our separate ways. Never expected he'd cause a scene at the Great Expo. Well... seems I'll have to pay him some special attention.
steps.female_content: Absolutely not! Back in my campaign days, I did try to work with her, but that woman is impossible! Naturally, we went our separate ways. Never expected she'd cause a scene at the Great Expo. Well... seems I'll have to pay her some special attention.

steps.speaker: Nirvana Representative
steps.content: Hmph, very well. But let me remind you, Speaker, Nirvana would prefer not to see you associating too closely with that kind of person.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Rest assured, man.
He bursts into laughter, draping his arm around the suited man's shoulders as they leave.
[White Out]

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: The Bureau personnel have arrived and will promptly provide first aid to this Sinner. A thorough evaluation for Mania will be carried out upon their return.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Chief, you seem somewhat reluctant to leave. Is there something else you'd like to do?
You mentally review the sequence of events that just unfolded.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Gather all the intelligence, including information on everyone who participated in the bidding and the entire process of granting entry to the delegation, and bring back everything about that Sinner from Fraser to the Bureau.
And then...

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: ...Take me with you. You're Sibilla's friend. I trust you.
You watch as the "dancer" is taken away, pausing briefly to reflect.
Let's head back to the Bureau for now.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Copy that.
[Scene Change]
In a secluded corner beyond the reach of the hall's commotion, Sibilla flees rapidly through a hidden passage.
The woman in red would return in no time. She must steer clear of her and evade those from Fraser, all the while taking care not to ruffle any feathers among the DisCity people.

The thought of going back among crowds stirs unprecedented anxiety in her. Danger lurks around every corner, and one wrong move could prove fatal. Yet, despite the risks, Sibilla finds herself unable to contain her exhilaration.
The person she worries for, the one she's been pursuing, the very reason for her arduous journey stands within arm's reach. Never has she been this close!

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: Thank goodness... Jasmine is safe now. She'll get better, thank goodness...

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: So that's Chief ${PlayerName}. I've finally found you.

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: I must tell him about the Campbell family. I must—
steps.female_content: I must tell her about the Campbell family. I must—

steps.content: My name is Sibilla. It means "whistle" in our language.
Warnings of coming calamities, prices of distant goods, secrets between neighbors... My voice has carried countless messages because it's precisely my job.
But not every message is for every ear.
I must ensure the information reaches those who truly need it...
